fields.name: blue_deposited
fields.description: Cumulative integer number of blue cubes successfully released into the bin during execution by this decision step, in every episode. Start at zero; increment once at the first decision step following each completed blue-cube deposit, including the final deposit. Do not increment at pickup or when issuing B. Preserve otherwise; newly appearing free cubes do not cancel completed deposits. e.g. 1
